creative_genome.body: A receipt-led system that turns source evidence, freshness, and transparent handoff into the premium idea.
creative_genome.alt: Abstract source receipt with a circular verification seal
creative_genome.targetAudience: Evidence-seeking D.C. adults 21+ wary of stale listings and unsupported claims
creative_genome.customerProblem: A storefront handoff lacks trust when source and freshness are hidden.
creative_genome.offer: See the source before choosing where to go.
creative_genome.visualConcept: An original source receipt with a verification rhythm and seal.
creative_genome.localDcCue: Three evidence lines and one source seal connect the visual to ORDERWEEDDC D.C. record labeling.
creative_genome.localDcRelevance: Applies ORDERWEEDDC source labeling to the D.C. discovery context.
creative_genome.imageSourcePlan: Rights-cleared deterministic vector fixture; no competitor or merchant asset.
creative_genome.desktopComposition: Wide evidence receipt beside source-led copy.
creative_genome.mobileComposition: Vertical receipt crop preserving the same lines and seal.
creative_genome.headline: See the source before the storefront.
creative_genome.landingPageMatch: Source and freshness labels on directory records.
creative_genome.negativePrompt: No official document, forged receipt, generated legal text, product pile, fake photography, or competitor expression.
authenticityRisks: Receipt form must remain clearly abstract.
unsupportedClaimRisks: Do not imply every record is verified current.
creative_genome.expectedMechanism: Evidence proximity builds trust before handoff.
creative_genome.testablePrediction: Owner-approved variant may increase qualified source-detail views; not yet tested.
